description:
Unofficial fork build of HushGram 0.0.7 for Instagram 450.0.0.50.77 (com.instagram.android) with 82 patches: the 78 from upstream plus four of its own, all off until you pick them: Glass tab bar (a floating glass tab bar with a sliding highlight and haptics), Save deleted messages (keeps the text of messages people delete on this phone), Saved on your profile (a bookmark among your profile's tabs that opens Saved) and Stop background wake-ups (stops two alarms that wake the phone while Instagram is in the background).

Checked by patching Instagram 450 in Morphe Manager and running it on an Android 15 emulator and an Android 16 phone; it hasn't been through upstream's release checks. Read Before you sign in in the README first. Patch the arm64-v8a build of Instagram 450.0.0.50.77, version code 385611438, and keep the manager's signing key so a new build installs over the old one and you stay signed in.
